conviction_note: Booking flow since Q2 (about $167M of disclosed Q3 awards plus $110M+ of acquired BlackSea funded backlog, then $41.6M and a ~$400M-ceiling IDIQ in Q4) and a revenue bar near the low end of the guide lean positive. Against that sit 2027 risk (Deep Strike roll-off, a CR to Dec 11 that bans new starts, and a peer's first 2027 guide landing below consensus), the Q2 pattern where a 30% revenue beat plus a raise fell about 8%, and a +14.8% 5-day bounce into the print with calls bid. The findings sum to +0.5. The scaled number is p_up 52 on an 11% absolute move = +0.44. The two agree because the evidence roughly offsets.
bar: Q3 revenue $150.8M (Earnings Whispers preview, 2026-11-03, https://www.earningswhispers.com/article/AVEX/22822) and $150.9M (Benzinga, https://www.benzinga.com/quote/AVEX/earnings-forecasts): two sources agree. Q3 EPS $0.09 per both, but other sources show $0.07 and $0.06, and the Q2 EPS figure itself is disputed (GAAP $0.07 vs $0.01 on aggregators), so EPS is not a usable bar. Benzinga's Q4 is $180.3M, so H2 is about $331M and FY about $750M. That equals the company's FY guide of $700-720M, which excludes BlackSea (https://s21.q4cdn.com/871107200/files/doc_financials/2026/q2/2Q26_Earnings-Release_Final.pdf), plus roughly $40-50M of BlackSea, a business run-rated at $150M/yr and closed 2026-09-08. The implied core H2 of about $284M sits at the low end of the $282-302M the guide implies.
positioning_check: Short interest is 3.0M shares, 6.7% of float, about 1.0 day to cover, down 25.4% from the prior period (StockTitan, read 2026-11-11, settlement date not shown: https://www.stocktitan.net/overview/AVEX/). The prior reading was 3.6M shares, 8.0% of float, 2.9 days to cover at the 2026-09-30 settlement (https://curvedtrading.com/stocks/avex/short-interest/). Not a crowded short. Baseline 25d skew is -15.86 vol points (calls bid, 'upside paid'), with put/call OI 0.91 and a 9-day straddle of 14.68%. Realised vol is 167% annualised, so the event-implied premium computes to 0. Run-up is +14.8% over 5 days off a November low of $8.95, -15.9% over 20 days, and -70.6% from the 52-week high. Retail sentiment flipped bullish after the 2026-10-21 crash (Stocktwits).

findings.finding: At 2026-06-30, funded backlog of $259.8M (95.1% expected to convert within 12 months) plus H2 awards covered more than 95% of the FY26 revenue guide midpoint, per management on the Q2 call. Consensus Q3 $150.8M plus Q4 $180.3M implies core (ex-BlackSea) H2 revenue of about $284M, near the bottom of the $282-302M the $700-720M guide implies, so Q3 revenue more likely lands at or above $150.8M than below it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 (2026-08-12 amc): revenue $201.8M vs about $155M consensus (+30%) with a FY raise, and the stock fell about 8.2% to $20.89 the next session (https://www.webull.com/news/15403586829444096). Q1 (2026-05-20 amc): +1.71% (baseline). Revenue beats have not paid.
findings.why_not_priced: Previews frame Q3 as a 'revenue cliff' (Earnings Whispers 2026-11-03: Q3 down about 25% QoQ) and do not set the consensus against the funded-backlog coverage. If the market priced the coverage, the bar would sit at mid-guide rather than the low end. This is inside what the company already guided, so it is small.
findings.independence: Q2 call transcript summary: '>95% of the revenue guidance midpoint is funded backlog', H2 adjusted EBITDA margin near 15% (https://www.tradingkey.com/news/transcripts/262105278-tradingkey). Shares the company as source.

findings.finding: AEVEX disclosed about $167M of Q3 awards (Jul 6 $17.5M, Jul 28 $88.1M, Aug 20 $41M, Sep 8 $20.5M), plus a SkyRange selection of up to $92.2M (Sep 11) and BlackSea's >$110M funded backlog (deal closed Sep 8). Against roughly $150M of Q3 revenue, that points to funded backlog rising from the $259.8M at Jun 30, which had halved from $503.1M at Dec 2025, and a Q3 book-to-bill at or above 1.0 against the 1.08 trailing figure.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: In Q2, funded backlog falling $243M in six months was the bear point beside the revenue beat, and the stock fell about 8% the next session. There is no prior case of backlog rising since the IPO to compare.
findings.why_not_priced: The preview narrative (Earnings Whispers 2026-11-03) leads with Deep Strike roll-off and a falling book-to-bill (1.16 to 1.08) and never adds up the Q3 award releases. If the market had added them, a sequential backlog rebuild would be talked about and the stock would not trade at 17-19x forward earnings after a 70% drawdown. Caveat: these are press-release ceilings and initial funding, a proxy for total bookings, not reported bookings.
findings.independence: $41M OWA award 2026-08-20 (https://s21.q4cdn.com/871107200/files/doc_news/AEVEX-Awarded-41-Million-Contract-to-Deliver-One-Way-Attack-Systems-2026.pdf); BlackSea >$110M funded backlog from the Q2 deal deck (https://s21.q4cdn.com/871107200/files/doc_financials/2026/q2/2Q26_Earnings-Call-Deck_FINAL.pdf). All company-sourced.

findings.finding: Two Q4 awards have landed since the quarter closed: a $41.6M Navy mine-countermeasures award across the GARC fleet and next-generation USVs (2026-10-30), and a multi-year IDIQ with a ceiling near $400M (2026-11-10, customer unnamed, initial task-order funding not disclosed). The stock rose only 0.3% on Nov 10, so the call's commentary on task-order timing and funded value is the thing still to be seen.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no comparable prior: this is the largest award disclosed since the IPO. Smaller award releases (Aug 25 and Sep 16 gap-ups per MarketBeat alerts) moved the stock a few percent.
findings.why_not_priced: An IDIQ ceiling with no funded value drew a 0.3% move (MarketChameleon close $11.60 on 2026-11-10), so the market is waiting for the funded value and may discount it to zero. If the ceiling were priced as orders, the stock would have rerated on the day. Partly priced: the next day's +2.8% into the print may already hold some of it.
findings.independence: $41.6M mine-countermeasures award (https://s21.q4cdn.com/871107200/files/doc_news/AEVEX-Awarded-41-6M-for-SightGlass-and-Fisher-Mine-Countermeasures-Systems-Across-GARC-Fleet-and-Next-Gen-USVs-2026.pdf); GovConWire coverage of the IDIQ (https://www.govconwire.com/articles/aevex-400m-idiq-unmanned-aircraft-systems).

findings.finding: This print is the first financial check on BlackSea since Bloomberg reported on 2026-10-20 that the Navy halted GARC purchases. The stock fell about 32% on 10-21, its worst day ever, to about $9.48. AEVEX said no orders were halted, that 325 GARCs were delivered under a completed 2025 order, that contract modifications took the value to about $350M through June 2027, and that the report does not affect Maritime Systems or its financial performance. The guide update that adds BlackSea (pitched at $150M FY26 revenue, EBITDA margin in line with AEVEX) will confirm or cut that.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The GARC report took about 32% off on 10-21. The company rebuttal bought +13.2% on 10-22. RBC (Outperform, target $26 to $22) called the sell-off a buying opportunity; Jefferies (Buy, $26) said it implied far broader BlackSea impairment than justified; Piper (Neutral, $20 to $13) flagged BlackSea sustainment backlog running off in mid-2027.
findings.why_not_priced: The stock is still about 15% below its 10-20 close of about $14 at $11.92. That gap is roughly what the market charges for BlackSea ($650M paid, about a third of AEVEX's value at signing) being impaired, against a company statement that it is not. If the market believed the rebuttal, the 10-21 gap would have closed. Two-way: a trimmed BlackSea outlook or any 2027 maritime softness reopens it, which the range reflects.
findings.independence: Stocktwits 2026-10-21 (Navy spokesperson: $136.8M on 24 prototypes and 301 GARCs, consistent with the 325 count; https://stocktwits.com/news-articles/markets/equity/avex-stock-crashes-to-fresh-52-week-lows-after-navy-reportedly-halts-drone-boat-orders-company-says-no-orders-were-stopped/cZxM1jORBwT); analyst split per https://stocktwits.com/news-articles/markets/equity/aevex-stock-rebounds-after-32-crash-rbc-calls-sell-off-a-buying-opportunity/cZxwLkERBDI.

findings.finding: Several things weigh on 2027. Deep Strike ($72.2M of Q2 revenue, the bulk of H1) has mostly run off, with only a 'small contribution' left for 2027. FY27 opened under a CR to 2026-12-11 that caps defense at FY26 levels and bans new starts and production-rate increases. AEVEX's guide assumed no prolonged CR. Kratos, the closest listed drone peer, reported Q3 in early November with a first 2027 outlook below consensus. Any 2027 framework on this call carries the same risk, against a Street pre-GARC 2028 figure of about $1.06B.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On 2026-08-13 the stock fell about 8% despite a beat and raise, as investors weighed 'revenue timing', meaning the H2 step-down. No 2027 guide has been given yet, so there is no prior on that line.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the stock is -70% from its high and previews flag Deep Strike roll-off. What is not in the previews is the specific CR ban on production-rate increases, which bears on new OWA and Launched Effects ramps, or the peer's below-consensus 2027 guide. If both were fully priced, sell-side targets ($28.73 average) would not sit at 2.4x spot. Transmission from the CR to AEVEX is macro, not company-confirmed; management said in August it expected no material 2026 effect.
findings.independence: Kratos Q3 2026 with a 2027 outlook below consensus (https://goldesel.de/aktien/news/kratos-defense-security-solutions-aktie-q3-ubertrifft-erwartungen-2027-ausblick-bleibt-darunter); Deep Strike roll-off on the Q2 call (https://www.tradingkey.com/news/transcripts/262105278-tradingkey); CR enacted to Dec 11 (https://spacepolicyonline.com/news/house-clears-fy2027-cr-now-to-the-president/).

findings.finding: The reaction function on this name sells good prints. Q2 brought a 30% revenue beat, a second FY raise and an accretive acquisition, and the stock fell about 8.2% the next session. Holders have since lived through a June secondary and lock-up waiver (-16%), an IPO class action, and the GARC crash, so a clean beat may again be used as exit liquidity.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Two post-IPO prints: Q1 +1.71% (baseline), Q2 about -8.2% on a beat and raise (webull/insidermonkey summary).
findings.why_not_priced: A reaction pattern rather than a fact the market has missed. It is filed so a judge can weigh it, because calls are bid (skew -15.9) as if a relief rally were the base case.
findings.independence: June secondary and lock-up waiver drop of about 16% (https://www.trefis.com/articles/601206/why-did-aevex-stock-plunge-16/2026-06-03).

findings.finding: The $250M cash leg of BlackSea exceeded the $215.2M of cash at Jun 30. Q3 will therefore show new borrowing and higher interest than the $11.5M FY26 net interest guide, which predates the deal. Purchase-accounting amortization, which the company said lowers GAAP EPS, will also enter. Together these put the GAAP EPS consensus of $0.09 at risk while adjusted EBITDA is unaffected.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 EPS was reported variously as $0.07 vs $0.06 and $0.01 vs $0.06, and the stock traded on revenue and backlog, not EPS.
findings.why_not_priced: The money buys a known $150M/yr business (financing that funds visible revenue), so this is mostly the accounting optics of a GAAP EPS miss, sized small.
findings.independence: Cash $215.2M at Q2 and two undrawn facilities (https://www.mitrade.com/insights/news/live-news/article-0-1997269-20260814). Shares the Q2 documents with finding 1.

findings.finding: Into the print the stock bounced +14.8% in five sessions off a November low of $8.95 to $11.92, calls are bid (25d skew -15.86, put/call OI 0.91), and short interest fell 25% to 6.7% of float and about 1 day to cover. Some of the relief has been paid for, and there is no crowded short to squeeze.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Big pre-event bounces on this name have faded: the 10-22 +13.2% rebound was followed by new lows in early November (Nov 4 -13.7% on no news, per MarketBeat).
findings.why_not_priced: This is the positioning itself, filed so the judges see that the skew and the run-up already lean up.

outside_window.finding: The CR expires 2026-12-11. Full-year FY27 appropriations, or another extension, decide whether new-start drone programs (Launched Effects, OWA ramps) can be funded, and that bears on 2027 bookings.

The IPO securities class action (class period 2026-04-17 to 2026-06-04, alleging an undisclosed pre-arranged lock-up waiver) has a lead-plaintiff deadline of 2026-10-20, already passed. Nothing in it resolves inside the window.

AeroVironment and other drone peers reporting after 2026-08-12: only Kratos found with a 2027 read

baseline_tension: The mild positive lean agrees with the upside-paid skew (-15.9) and the +14.8% 5-day bounce, so part of it is likely priced. It cuts against the -15.9% 20-day trend and the beats-sold history, which keeps p_up near 50.
lessons_applied: Lesson 1/6 (inside the guide, beats sold): revenue-coverage finding cut from +0.5 to +0.3.
Lesson 3 (two-sided caveat): BlackSea/GARC verification finding cut from +1.0 to +0.8, keeping the wide -5/+5 band.

Lesson 7 (sign against the upside-paid skew, short not crowded): 2027/CR negative cut from -1.5 to -1.2 and kept, because the CR text and the Kratos 2027 guide are the stated reason the skew may be wrong.
Lessons 2/4 (one-off below operating income; financing funds a known acquisition): GARC-independent EPS/interest finding cut from -0.3 to -0.2.
Net: impact_sum is unchanged at +0.5 (the cuts offset); p_up 52 and abs_move 11 unchanged.
